Rosebank Field Development

16 July 2026 Addition of Public Notices as advertised in the Daily Telegraph, Press & Journal and the Shetland Times.

16 July 2026 Addition of Regulation 12(5)(c) public notice and further information submitted in response to Regulation 12(1) notice for further information dated 27 March 2026.

9 July 2026 Addition of Regulation 12(3) Notice

22 June 2026 A response to the further information notice issued 27/03/2026 under Regulation 12(1) of the EIA Regulations has been received from the Developer on 19/06/2026

1 April 2026 Document titled ‘Redacted representations to the public notice’ has been updated.

27 March 2026 A further information notice under Regulation 12(1) of the EIA Regulations has been issued and a copy of the notice is provided on the website. Redacted Representations received relating to the further information submitted on 25th September 2025 are uploaded to the website.

5 February 2026 The website has been updated to show that the developer of the Rosebank Field Development Environmental Statement is changed from “Equinor UK Limited” to “Adura Operations Limited”.

21 October 2025 Addition of Public Notices in Newspaper publications.

15 October 2025 Addition of key dates for further information public notice commencement and closing dates. Update of further information public notice line to reflect commencement date.

15 October 2025 Addition of further information and public notice submitted in response to regulation 12(1) notice dated 21 July 2025.

14 October 2025 Regulation 12(3) Notice relating to further information received.

26 September 2025 The website has been updated to show that the rosebank ES is changed from “determined” to “under-review”. Under Further information, the date received has been added for the developer response to the Secretary of State request for further information dated 21-07-25.

22 July 2025 New Regulation 12(1) Notice for further information added.

28 September 2023 Rosebank Field Development decision documents uploaded, and relevant dates entered under details.

1 March 2023 Further Information: Confirmation that response received from developer to Regulation 12(1) letter.

16 February 2023 Further information request notice in relation to the proposed Rosebank development, sent to Equinor UK Limited on 15/02/2023

28 December 2022 Further Information: Confirmation that response received from developer to Regulation 12(1) letter.

12 December 2022 Addition of further information request notice in relation to the proposed Rosebank development sent to Equinor UK Limited on 9-12-22 and located here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/rosebank-field-development

22 August 2022 Rosebank ES public notice documents uploaded

12 August 2022 Submission of Rosebank Environmental Statement and Public Notice

4 August 2022 First published.
